fact: The October 2025 issue (No. 10, 2025) of a Chinese Academy of Sciences desert locust bulletin, from a system that regularly releases maps and reports, states that satellite monitoring found locusts affected 15.2 thousand hectares of vegetation in Eritrea in September 2025, 4.8 thousand of it cropland.
title: Report of Monitoring, Early Warning of Desert Locust: Desert Locust Monitoring and Loss Assessment in Eritrea, Saudi Arabia and Yemen (September 2025)
publisher: Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences
